حَصًى رَمِضٌ , (TA,) and أَرْضٌ رَمِضَةٌ, (A, TA,) [Pebbles, and ground or land,] vehemently heated by the sun; or intensely heated by the vehement action of the sun thereupon. (A.) And أَرْضٌ رَمِضَةُ الحَجَارَةٍ Land of which the stones are vehemently heated by the sun. (S.) [See also ↓ رَمْضَآءُ .] ―
-b2- رَمِضَةٌ (assumed tropical:) A woman whose thighs rub each other. (Ibn-' Abbád, Sgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
